title: Handling of DNN based congestion control
text: The AMF may detect and start performing DNN based congestion control when one or more DNN congestion criteria as specified in 3GPPTS23.501[8] are met. If the UE does not provide a DNN for a non-emergency PDU session, then the AMF uses the selected DNN or the DNN associated with the PDU session corresponding to the 5GSM procedure

When DNN based congestion control is activated at the AMF, the AMF performs the congestion control as specified in subclause5.4.5 and the UE performs the congestion control as specified in subclause5.4.5 and subclause6.2.7
